equivalence_proof.argument: Old backward scan finds the rightmost adjacent colon pair and extends its start left across the complete same run, returning the prefix before the rightmost maximal colon run of length>=2. The current qualifier_component_extents iterator excludes exactly such complete runs; written_separator_extent records its last gap (including trailing/all-colon gaps). Therefore separator.start is the identical old prefix length. With no run, old empty prefix equals new None default. Lone colons, Unicode, invalid-UTF8 and NUL are ordinary counted bytes in both; no truncation, normalization, extra byte validation or allocation is added. The result borrows the same original input extent.
equivalence_proof.consumer_scope: String adapter and actual rename-transition producer bodies are unchanged. Native byte producer still first selects C rename_destination_input under actual original recipe; Logical literal input remains distinct. Namespace Ensure/Delete metadata grants no publication, namespace existence or completion.
